headline: Housing construction revival – 22% more new homes handed over in the first half of the year
summary: Hungary's housing construction market picked up in the first half of 2026, with new homes handed over up 22% on the previous year, according to the Central Statistical Office.
why: Housing construction activity is a key indicator of economic momentum, shaping demand for building materials, credit and property development.
